free_text: Despite the Verifier suggesting deferral, the panel's decision is supported by the cohort criterion (PI-RADS 4) which matched the reading urologist in 16 of 18 cases with a prior negative biopsy. The decision is borderline because the PSA density of 0.15 ng/mL² is at the upper limit of the low-risk category per the EAU guideline. The evidence converged on biopsy due to the high PI-RADS score, and the retrieved documents did not provide a specific value to overturn this consensus.
